r0.why: Basis of geology and paleontology (1), oldest at bottom in undeformed sequences (2), assumptions of stratigraphic dating (3).

r1.why: Not deformed beyond 90 degrees, relative ages of fossils, most archaic lowest (4); coexisting vs successive species (5).

r2.why: Steno 1669 Dissertationis prodromus (6), William Strata Smith and first geologic map of Britain (7), first of Smith's laws 1816-1819 (8).

r3.why: Archaeological layering differs (9), need not run top to bottom (10), undercutting and drain back-fill (11, 12), doors and windows (13), interpretation needed (14).

r4.why: Disruption by animals, vegetation, limestone crystallization (15); lava flows and ash falls, law may not always apply (16).
